newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Mayne sees very strong year result.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Mayne sees very strong year result.

text.p: Transport, security and health care group Mayne Nickless said on Thursday it was well placed for a strong result in the year to June 30, 1997.

"We are seeing ourselves well placed now to have a very strong year result...We are confident that we can deliver at the moment and we are two months into the half," Mayne managing director Bob Dalziel told reporters.
Dalziel said a change in the mix of Mayne's buinesses meant that it was no longer the case that the company's second half was weaker than the first half.
Mayne reported a fall in net profit to A$43.14 million for the six months to December 31, but operating profit rose 8.1 percent to A$88.145 million.
There was an A$21.42 million abnormal loss.
